sample_without_replacement: sample n elements without replacement from a population of size n using a random state
test_sample_without_replacement: test the sklearn.utils.random.sample_without_replacement function with various population sizes
refactor_random_choice_csc: refactor _random_choice_csc to generate a sparse CSC matrix from column class distributions
create_random_choice_csc: create a sparse random CSC matrix with column-specific class probability distributions
review_random_choice_csc: review _random_choice_csc for generating sparse random matrices from class distributions
